scene_description: Two wood-grain tables hold a closed red-and-black Fahrenheit box on the left and a green spiral notebook near the front of the right table. A blue tape-covered cube rests on the notebook. An open dark blue Vandoren reed box overlaps the notebook right edge, with a wrapped packet protruding from its open end.

vlm_input.question: Given the image and the task, robot, and status context, what should the human change, if anything, to prevent or resolve problems with this interaction? Return only a JSON object containing an ordered guidance_specs array; use an empty array if no intervention is needed.
vlm_input.task_context: The robot will collect only the green notebook and carry it to a desk. The blue cube, reed box, and Fahrenheit package must remain on the tables.
vlm_input.robot_context: The robot has one claw gripper with parallel jaws and manipulates one object at a time. It pinches the notebook front edge with one jaw above and one below, using the visible overhang. It lifts the notebook as a whole without independently holding objects on its cover.

guidance_specs.target_object: blue tape-covered cube resting near the center of the green spiral notebook
constraints: Lift it slightly clear of the cover during relocation
Set it fully on the table without contacting the Fahrenheit box
guidance_specs.context: Move the cube off the notebook onto the clear tabletop between the notebook and Fahrenheit box.

guidance_specs.target_object: dark blue individually wrapped reed packet protruding from the open end of the Vandoren box
constraints: Slide the wrapped packet along the box opening without bending it
Do not close the flaps on the protruding packet
guidance_specs.context: Push the protruding packet fully inside the Vandoren box before closing its end.

guidance_specs.target_object: open end flaps of the dark blue Vandoren reed box beside the green notebook
constraints: Fold in the small flaps and tuck the main flap closed
Keep all packets inside and avoid crushing them
guidance_specs.context: Close the reed box end so its packets stay inside during handling.

guidance_specs.target_object: open dark blue Vandoren reed box lying diagonally along the green notebook right edge
constraints: Keep the entire box supported inside the table edge
Clear the notebook cover and edge before pickup
guidance_specs.context: Move the closed reed box right until it no longer overlaps the notebook.

review.problem: The cube rests on the notebook and the reed box overlaps its edge; lifting the notebook could carry or dislodge them. The protruding packet and open box also need containment before the box is moved.
review.rationale: Remove the cube, put the protruding packet inside and close the box, then move the box clear before the notebook lift.
